briefTitle: Optimal Intravesical Lidocaine Volume for Pain Relief During Office Intra-detrusor Onabotulinum Toxin a Injections
officialTitle: Optimal Intravesical Lidocaine Volume for Pain Relief During Office Intra-detrusor Onabotulinum Toxin a Injections: a Prospective Randomized Superiority Trial

arms.label: Higher volume intravesical lidocaine
arms.description: 200 ml of 2% lidocaine without epinephrine intravesical instillation 20-30 minutes prior to bladder botox.

arms.label: Lower volume intravesical lidocaine
arms.description: 30 ml of 2% intravesical lidocaine without epinephrine instilled into the bladder 20-30 minutes prior to bladder botox.

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult female, \>18 years, English-speaking (surveys utilized are not validated in all languages)
* Able to provide informed consent
* Indications: Refractory urge urinary incontinence, Refractory urinary urgency and frequency, Neurogenic bladder (without sensory deficit)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Untreated urinary tract infection at the time of procedure
* Contra-indication to Botox
* Contraindication to intravesical lidocaine
* Inability to provide informed consent
* Pregnancy, breast-feeding, intending to become pregnant within 6 months of treatment
